note: Export side is factually confirmed, not merely declared: dated customs/B-L records with destination, HS code and B/L number exist for 2026-02-23 through 2026-02-27 (New Zealand, Australia, UAE, Lithuania, Romania) plus a 2024-10-01 France air consignment. Declared HS set 071140;200110;200190 matches the observed records — actual codes seen are 20011000 (gherkins/cornichons in vinegar) and 20019000 (jalapeno slices in vinegar); no 071140 (dried leguminous vegetables) row was observed in the visible sample, so 071140 is unverified but not a rejection ground. Company appears to be a processor/exporter of pickled gherkins and jalapenos operating out of Bangalore ICD (INWFD6) and Bangalore Air; address on record: NO.15, RACE COURSE ROAD, GUNIDY. Role: manufacturer_trader is plausible (own branded packs 'GOLDEN SUN', 'ANIRA' plus third-party labels) but not verified from a registry — registries were out of scope/blocked. Domestic supply: no traces found in accessible sources; this is a data-access gap, not evidence of absence, hence 'unknown' rather than 'none_found'. Revenue: null (not public in accessible sources). No sanctions/court/HS issues relevant to rejection; company is not rejected.
